---
title: Tools
---

`open-eda-file-tools` is one project at one version: a collection of EDA
data-file libraries and their command-line front ends, released together from
a single tag.

| Tool | Library | Commands | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Liberty `.lib` parser, writer, viewer and formatter | `liberty_tools` | `liberty-view`, `liberty-tools format` | shipped |
| Cell LEF parser and query tools | `lef_tools` | `lef-tools` | shipped (alpha) |
| DEF parser, binary cache and design queries | `def_tools` | `def-tools` | shipped (alpha) |
| SDC clock extraction | `sdc_tools` | `sdc-tools` | shipped (alpha) |
| VCD toggle-count profiler | `vcd_tools` (reserved) | — | on the way |

Every tool shares the project version (`VERSIONING_PLAN.md`); there are no
per-tool version numbers.

## Adding a tool

1. Create the tool's Python package at the repository root (`<name>_tools/`)
   and add it to `[tool.maturin] include` in `pyproject.toml`. It is a library
   of this project, not a separate project: there is only the root
   `pyproject.toml`.
2. Add its command-line entry points to `[project.scripts]` in the root
   `pyproject.toml`, kebab-case and prefixed with the file format it reads
   (`liberty-…`, `vcd-…`, `lef-…`, `def-…`).
3. If it has a Rust backend, add its module under `src/` and register its
   classes/functions in `_native` (`src/lib.rs`).
4. Add its tests under `tests/` and add the tool to the table above and to
   `README.md`.

## Shared conventions

- All tests live in `tests/` at the repository root and run in a single
  `uv run pytest -q` invocation.
- `BUILD.md` covers the toolchain, `CLAUDE.md` covers the repository structure
  and the invariants a tool must preserve.
- There is one release history for the project: tags in `vYYYY.M.D` form, with
  `.N` appended for a second release on the same day (`VERSIONING_PLAN.md`),
  pointing at commits where every tool is at the released version.
